title: Bounded CLI reads and deliberate full detail
summary: Reads declare no side effects; event emission makes a function a write. The generated read catalog and dispatcher use the same classification. Routine replies use concise command-specific projections and pages. JSON envelopes and write replies remain complete. Only oversized registered human reads refuse atomically above 28,000 UTF-8 bytes; the refusal names the field, filter, limit and paging flags that command really has, or --full for complete human detail.
